title: Code-Switching Speech Corpus
decision_reason: The release resegments a subset of the pre-existing German Spoken Wikipedia Corpus rather than contributing a separable new primary-production collection or a clearly isolatable new manual phonetic annotation layer meeting current scope.
evidence_summary: Zenodo describes the resource as means to resegment a subset of the German Spoken Wikipedia Corpus (SWC). SWC itself contains volunteer-read Wikipedia recordings and manually annotated word/segment XML, but the present deposit is secondary reuse/resegmentation of that pre-existing corpus. Under the database rule excluding secondary reuse unless genuinely new manual annotations can be isolated, do not admit as a new core source or duplicate the underlying recordings.
